title: Pagination drops the last page
description: A catalogue API cannot show the final, partially filled page. Compare a plausible one-line fix with a minimal correct fix: only one of them survives the regression suite.
issue: Customers report that the last items in a category never show up. With 11 products and 5 per page, the API says there are 2 pages and page 3 returns 'out of range'.

patches.label: Plausible fix: add one page
patches.description: The kind of quick fix an assistant often suggests: always add one page. It makes the reported tests pass.

patches.label: Minimal fix: ceiling division
patches.description: Round up only when there is a partial page.

patches.label: Unsafe: change the test instead
patches.description: Makes the failure disappear by editing the test's expectation. Tests are evidence, so this is blocked.
